Physical Dimensions & Structural Layout • Inside Clear Height (ICH): 35' (thirty feet) • Inside Clear Width (ICW): 30' (thirty feet) • Structural Joinery: Flange in the top beam to facilitate transport, rapid assembly, and structural modularity. 2. Load, Travel, & Gradeability Specs • Lift Capacity: 180 ton or higher load capacity, speciﬁcally engineered to transport the designated heavy concrete target blocks that meet HHSTT speciﬁcations. • Gradeability: 3% or higher under full operational load. • Drive Conﬁguration: Closed-loop hydrostatic drive system paired with hydraulically driven All Wheel Steering (AWS) and All-Wheel Drive (AWD) for optimized maneuverability on compacted soils. 3. Mechanical, Hoisting, & Hydraulic Systems • Hoist System: 2-speed (dual range) hoists featuring a low-mounted, large-diameter grooved hoist drum to optimize spooling and minimize wire rope wear. • Hydra

hose covers to protect lines from mechanical abrasion and UV exposure. 4. Electrical, Lighting, & Instrumentation • Diagnostic Capabilities: Integrated remote diagnostics system with real-time hydraulic pump pressure and temperature monitoring. • Work Area Illumination: High-intensity DC-LED Work and Drive Lights. • Power Controls: Full-function Wireless Remote Control alongside primary cab controls. 5. Environmental, Cab, & Safety Features • Operator Cab: Enclosed, weather-sealed operator's compartment equipped with a heavy-duty HVAC heating and A/C unit. • Acoustics: Level 1 Sound Suppression system. • Alarms & Visual Warnings: Travel warning system consisting of four (4) directional travel alarms and high-visibility strobe lights. • Fire Safety: Integrated ﬁre extinguisher in the operator cab. • Emergency Isolation: Dedicated emergency stops located at each of the wheel frames. 6. L’Union des Comores, avec le soutien de la Banque mondiale, met en œuvre la WASH pour l’accès accéléré à l’eau, à l’assaini

; des infrastructures WASH résilientes au climat. entity_geography.text: n Foreign Procurements-Notice and Representation (Jun 2020) (a) Deﬁnitions. As used in this provision- Foreign person means any person other than a United States person. Speciﬁed Federal procurement payment means any payment made pursuant to a contract with a foreign contracting party that is for goods, manufactured or produced, or services provided in a foreign country that is not a party to an international procurement agreement with the United States. United States person as deﬁned in 26 U.S.C. 7701(a)(30) means (1) A citizen or resident of the United States; (2) A domestic partnership; (3) A domestic corporation; (4) Any estate (other than a foreign estate, within the meaning of 26 U.S.C. 701(a)(31)); and (5) Any trust if- (i) A court within the United States is able to exercise primary supervision over the administration of the trust; and (ii) One or more United States persons have the authority to control all substantial decisions of the trust.
